description.html: Cork bark is one of the most versatile and popular natural materials for decorating terrariums. It comes from the cork oak and is completely safe to use with reptiles. Its unique texture and natural look make it ideal for creating an authentic, natural environment in the terrarium, while its function goes beyond a purely decorative role.

Cork bark serves several purposes in a terrarium. Arboreal reptiles such as crested geckos, day geckos and anoles use it as a platform for climbing and resting, because its rough surface provides excellent grip. Ground-dwelling reptiles such as leopard geckos and snakes use it as a hide, especially when it is set up as a tunnel or a half-round shelter. Flat pieces can serve as a terrarium background or as a basking platform under a heat lamp.

One of the most important advantages of cork bark is its resistance to moisture and mold, which makes it perfect for tropical terrariums with high humidity. It is light and easy to shape - it can be cut, broken and arranged as needed. It is fully compatible with bioactive terrarium setups. It is durable and long-lasting and does not rot easily even in humid conditions, which makes it an economical choice for long-term use.
It is suitable for all reptile species, regardless of terrarium type - from desert to tropical setups.
